SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_quarter,
  CASE 
    WHEN s.region = 'Online' THEN 'Web'
    ELSE s.region 
  END as region,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, s.region
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, s.region

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN s.region = 'Online' THEN 'Web'
    ELSE s.region 
  END as region,
  d.fiscal_year,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND s.region != 'Head office'
GROUP BY region, d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY region, d.fiscal_year DESC

WITH regional_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN s.region = 'Online' THEN 'Web'
      ELSE s.region 
    END as region,
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND s.region != 'Head office'
  GROUP BY region, d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  region,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) as fy2025_26_q3,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) as fy2024_25_q3,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END)) /
    NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END), 0) * 100, 
    2
  ) as growth_percentage
FROM regional_sales
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND s.region != 'Head office'

SELECT COUNT(*) as negative_or_null_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND (f.net_amount < 0 OR f.net_amount IS NULL)

SELECT

WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2025
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) IN (10, 11, 12)

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN s.region = 'Online' THEN 'Web'
      ELSE s.region 
    END as region,
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as gross_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND s.region != 'Head office'
  GROUP BY region, d.fiscal_year
),
returns_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN s.region = 'Online' THEN 'Web'
      ELSE s.region 
    END as region,
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(f.refund_net) as returns
  FROM fact_return_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.return_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND s.region != 'Head office'
  GROUP BY region, d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.region, r.region) as region,
  COALESCE(s.fiscal_year, r.fiscal_year) as fiscal_year,
  COALESCE(s.gross_sales, 0) as gross_sales,
  COALESCE(r.returns, 0) as returns,
  COALESCE(s.gross_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns, 0) as net_sales
FROM sales_data s
FULL OUTER JOIN returns_data r 
  ON s.region = r.region AND s.fiscal_year = r.fiscal_year
ORDER BY region, fiscal_year DESC
